head: App Launcher widget for iPhone puts 100+ apps on one home screen page
dek: App Launcher: Home Screen is a free iPhone and iPad app that turns one full-page widget into a grid of more than 100 app icons, plus two lock screen widgets with eight apps each. It was #89 among free Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 20 November.
details: The free version gives a 6 by 10 grid; Launcher Pro unlocks grids up to 8 by 13 on iPhone (16 by 8 on iPad), hides icon names, adds icon shapes and outlines and removes the ads, as a yearly subscription with three free days, a monthly one or a one-time lifetime purchase. You can place icons anywhere, leave gaps, add websites as icons and back up your layout to a file. It needs iOS 27, has no account, and is made by developer Andrei Terekhin; it came out on 12 November.
where: App Store, iPhone and iPad with iOS 27, free with ads; Pro by subscription or one-time purchase
means: If your apps are spread over many home screen pages, this fits far more of them on one.
todo: Search App Launcher: Home Screen on the App Store, add its full-page widget and tap the empty spots to place your apps.
